text: とりポケモンに　あまえ　られると　しあわせ…

structure.jp: とりポケモンに　あまえ　られると
structure.en: when a bird Pokémon cuddles up to me

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: られる says the action is done to the speaker, and に shows who does it. とりポケモンに　あまえ　られる = 'to be cuddled up to by a bird Pokémon'.

patterns.name: 〜と (when)
patterns.explanation: と after a verb means 'when' or 'whenever' that happens, the next thing follows. あまえ　られると　しあわせ = 'when I get cuddled up to, I'm happy'.
